top_signals.title: Wall Street Banks to Lead $3 Billion Debt Deal for CD&R Purchase
top_signals.summary: A group of Wall Street banks have been tapped to lead a $3.1 billion financing for private equity firm Clayton, Dubilier & Rice and McKesson Corp.’s acquisition of Option Care Health, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
